prior_correction: Bayes odds rescaling from the training-fit prevalence (same cluster-grouped 90/10 split as the trainers) to MLLS-EM on unlabelled target scores (deployable) or to the true target prevalence (oracle)

references.pooled_erm_oracle: uses the true target prevalence; ceiling of prior correction

threshold_metrics: at 0.5 on the corrected probability, which is the Bayes rule for the estimated target prior
auroc_note: AUROC is invariant to the (monotone) prior correction
